prompt: My character reference images are stored in Supabase storage. How do I reference them?
expected: Use the Supabase storage base URL and append the filename: {bucket_url}/{character}_reference_{nn}_{pose}.jpg. Provide the full URL as the reference in the kie.ai API call.
pass: constructs the correct Supabase storage URL for the character reference
fail: doesn't support Supabase storage or constructs a wrong URL

prompt: My character reference images are on Google Drive with file IDs. How do I reference them?
expected: Use the Google Drive API URL format: https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/{FILE_ID}?alt=media&key={API_KEY}. Provide the full URL as the reference in the kie.ai API call.
pass: constructs the correct Google Drive URL for the file ID

prompt: I need to generate an image of my brand's mascot in a new scene. I have 8 reference images including front and 3/4 face shots.
expected: Always include the front and 3/4 face anchor refs in the first 2 slots; fill remaining slots with pose refs scored by keyword match against the new scene description.
pass: keeps face anchors in the first 2 slots and rotates pose refs from the rest
fail: randomizes or drops the face anchors

prompt: grok-imagine/image-to-image returned a 500 error saying 'field is required'. What's wrong?
expected: Check that the ref key is image_urls for grok models and input_urls for flux models. Also check the ref count is at most 5 for grok.
pass: identifies the wrong key name or count limit and fixes it
fail: assumes the model is down and switches to fallback unnecessarily

prompt: My images look the same across different days despite different scene prompts. The character is recognisable but the scene barely changes. What do I adjust?
expected: Lower the strength parameter from 0.85 to 0.6-0.7 to let the prompt influence the composition more. Or add explicit shot-size/framing contrast per variant.
pass: recommends lowering strength or adding framing contrast as the fix
fail: suggests changing the reference images or adding more scenes to the prompt pool

prompt: Yesterday the scene was a lakeside walk at sunrise. How do I avoid generating the same scene tomorrow?
expected: Use an anti-repeat deque (track last 14 scenes used) that refuses to reuse a scene until it falls out of the window. The prompt composer should check this and pick a different scene.
pass: explains the deque pattern with a 14-entry window
fail: suggests manually tracking scenes or reusing the same scene
